description: VKR-L3 v0.2 static checks (0003 sections 4 and 5): typing, fixed flow rules H1 to H5, endorsement.

vectors.note: missing-required-arg: a required parameter without an argument is a static error
record-width-subtype-accepted: a record with extra fields is a subtype of the parameter record
ref-through-optional-rejected: an argument cannot be taken through an optional field
parallel-on-write-rejected: parallel is allowed only for compute and read capabilities
h1-secret-in-when-to-egress: a secret that only decides whether an egress step runs still reaches it
h2-untrusted-recipient: an untrusted value cannot fill a target parameter of an egress capability
h2-not-lifted-by-approval: approval with provenance endorses the control label only; H3 is lifted, H2 is not
h3-direct-write-under-untrusted-when: untrusted data cannot decide whether a direct write happens
h3-quarantine-write-accepted: under an untrusted control label a write to a quarantine capability is allowed
h3-lifted-by-approval-provenance: approval: true under an untrusted control label becomes approval with provenance
declassify-secret-rejected: a value with a secret class cannot be declassified
ask-without-content-still-a-sink: an ask with neither options nor show still yields a flow, so a secret control label is caught
declassify-drop-secret-rejected: drop cannot name a secret class, so a secret control label cannot be stripped
h5-untrusted-value-in-url-prop: an untrusted value binds only to text props of a view
consequential-needs-approval: carried over from v0.1 R7: a consequential capability requires approval: true
no-policy-denies-labelled-flow: without a policy every flow whose label is not bottom is denied
